item.title: DAWN AEROWAR
item.description:
Title: DAWN AEROWAR
Genre: Adventure , Indie
Developer: Jose Pavli , Neiwa Interactive
Publisher: Neiwa Interactive
Release Date: Nov 10, 2026




About This Game




The 77-minute original soundtrack is also on Steam. Get it together with the film in the Dawn Aerowar bundle, just above this section.


The question we get the most: do you fly the planes?

No. Dawn Aerowar is a two-hour animated film in twelve episodes. You watch it the way you watch a film or a series.

There is no gameplay and you never take the controls of a plane. One story, one character, one mission and one ending.

You follow Zodiac 1, an ace pilot out for revenge against the Empire that took everything from him.

Around the film, the player has a few interactive extras: a War Room map that follows the mission, files on the characters and the world, and the radio archive. More details below.




A handful of independent artists spent years on it, mixing 3D animation, hand-drawn 2D art and a professional voice cast.

Self-published by Neiwa Interactive and funded by more than 600 backers on Kickstarter.

Every copy supports independent animation





In a world scarred by years of war, the Free Nations stand on the brink of annihilation. The Saal'Runa Empire has crushed every resistance but one.

Zodiac escorts a weapon no one should know exists, on one last sortie across the whole Empire.






Zodiac lost his family, his home and his purpose to the Empire. Revenge is all he has left.

He faces enemies in the air, at sea and on land. Three of them stand above all the others.



Reaper , the Name of Death, loves war more than peace.

Freya , the Imperial Goddess, quotes philosophers in the middle of a dogfight.

Miracle , the Guardian Angel, is known for the lives she saved rather than the ones she took.



Zodiac flies alone, guided by an AWACS operator he had never heard of before.

Sharp and talkative, she seems to know a lot about him, and just about everything about the war.





Voiced by Sam Hughes, Kira Buckland, Lara Sawalha, Blythe Melin, Sandra Espinoza, Mark Mullens, Jeremiah Foltz and over thirty additional voices.

A 77-minute original score composed to picture by Jose Pavli, the composer of Project Wingman. Orchestra, choirs, Bulgarian voices, classical guitar and two original songs.




Before the first episode, you choose how to watch.

Operations mode : follow Zodiac's mission from the War Room and come back to it after each episode.

Cinematic mode : the 12 episodes play back to back, and the War Room opens once the film is over.

You can switch modes at any time. Subtitles in English, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Russian. Steam achievements included.




The War Room is built around a map of the continent. Zodiac's route is drawn on it step by step.

Each step opens its episode, to launch or watch again, along with the files linked to it.



The steps ahead stay encrypted until you have watched the episode before them. Nothing on the map gets ahead of the film.




Files collects what you learn along the way: the characters you meet, the places Zodiac flies over and a glossary of the war.

New files appear after each episode, and older ones grow as you learn more about someone you met earlier.






Communications keeps the transcript of every radio exchange from the episodes you have watched. Search it and play any transmission again. Channels from later episodes stay locked.

While watching, you can also save a 90-second clip with sound or a screenshot of any moment.

System Requirements

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Any
    • VR Support: No

item.title: GroundInFlames
item.description:
Title: GroundInFlames
Genre: Strategy , Early Access
Developer: VasyliyBritva
Publisher: VasyliyBritva
Franchise: Inflames
Release Date: Nov 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 10, 2026




About This Game

The War Where Everything Counts

GroundInFlames — real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare,

top-down view. There is no base to build up, and no army that

appears out of thin air. There is a sector of the front, trenches, treelines, villages, and resources you can use, of which you have a limited amount

A Trench, Not a Map

  • Squads, not units. Soldiers take cover on their own, go prone under fire, get suppressed and break morally. A suppressed squad will not carry out an order — you have to pull it out and let it recover.

  • The terrain works. Trees, bushes, walls, smoke and folds in the ground cut visibility. The canopy is treated as a separate layer: shelling strips the foliage, and a treeline whose forest has been shot away stops providing cover.

  • Fortification. Trenches get dug, dugouts get built, communication trenches connect positions. All of it wears down under fire and collapses.

  • Building assaults. You don't have to spend valuable infantry on a pointless assault of a fortified building — it's enough to blow the wall apart with a tank and enter through the breach you've made.

The Drone War

  • FPV . Drone mechanics are among the most important in the game, and we managed to build them so that they don't cause discomfort when playing the technical side, while being just as effective as in reality.

  • Recon drones . The same kind of UAV as FPV, differing only in field of view; carries no armament

  • EW and signal. Every operator has their own frequency on which they launch the drone, and EW systems have their own operating frequencies — they may not match, and then the drone won't be jammed.

Armor and Module Mechanics for Vehicles

  • Penetration accounting for impact angle; ricochets and non-penetrations are also present.

  • The running gear is a separate layer in front of the hull side. A shell can tear off a track, can pass through it into the side, or can do both.

  • The crew has positions: driver, gunner, commander. Infantry riding in an open bed is vulnerable to bullets

  • Ammunition detonation, a burning vehicle, and a fire that lives a life of its own.

  • Anti-drone cage armor is not decoration: the grille disrupts the shaped-charge jet and scatters fragments on the side the hit came from.

People Run Out

  • Mobilization resource replenishes slowly — show success at the front and you'll get more volunteers

  • Forced conscription gives you people immediately and adds discontent in the rear. A rear that has stopped working means no quality supply.

  • Prisoners. You can take enemy soldiers prisoner

  • Wounded and medics. A wounded man can be dragged out, or can be lost while you're deciding whether it's worth going after him.

Fog of War

Each side knows exactly what it has seen with its own eyes, and exactly from the

moment it saw it. A burned-out vehicle stays intact on the enemy's map

until someone goes and takes a look. Shelling from twenty kilometers away: you won't see the effects of your hits, though you'll know the positions you struck.

And Also

  • Direct control of every unit in the game, if you feel like doing the work yourself.

  • Mortars, smoke, grenades, RPGs, heavy machine guns on vehicles.

  • Supply: Deliver supplies to the front on time.

  • Key points, scoring by margin, a battle log that records every clash with the enemy — what happened while you were looking the other way.

  • Russian and English interface languages.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

We use AI tools as part of our development pipeline: some images were generated with AI, and AI-assisted tools support parts of the production process. Everything produced this way is reviewed, edited and integrated by hand - the design, gameplay systems and final content are our own work.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: Stormforge
item.description:
Title: Stormforge
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: Roboto Games
Publisher: Roboto Games
Release Date: Nov 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 10, 2026




About This Game

Storms in the land of Sorana work like dungeons out in the open world. Each one is guarded by tornadoes that hunt you and hazards that keep you on your toes, from lightning strikes to toxic clouds and fire spurts. Break the crystal to clear the storm for good, then set out to find the next one.

  • Hunting Tornadoes - Outrun or glide around tornadoes that hunt you down, hurling trees, boulders and even enemies at you

  • Storm Guardians - Destroy the generators or find other ways to bring down the shield and fight storm-powered enemies protecting the storm's crystal

  • Storm Rewards - Gather resources infused with storm magic, and earn skill points from the storms you clear

  • Roaming Chaos Storms - Seek shelter and protect your base with a magic shield while large chaos storms sweep across the entire map

Build your base piece by piece, or move into an abandoned village house and make it your own. Place a crystal pillar at its heart to shield it from the chaos storms.

  • Round Building Pieces - Build round walls and floors from your very first camp

  • Craft From Storage - Craft straight from any chest within your crystal pillar's radius

  • Quick-Stack & Free Repairs - Sort your whole inventory into matching chests with one button, and repair your gear for free

  • Free Placement - Switch between basic snapping, advanced snapping and free placement, and overlap pieces however you like

Set out across a procedurally generated world the storms have reshaped, with a new map for every world you create.

  • 3 Biomes - Travel from the Whispering Vale and the Howling Woods to the Ember Canyons

  • Creatures Enhanced by the Storms - Hunt Galewings that escape on mini tornadoes, Mistwolves immune to harm while in mist form and Thunderhoof deer that blink out of bow range

  • Ocean Travel - Build a boat and sail to distant islands in search of new storms to cleanse from the land

  • Titan Ruins & Dungeons - Delve into dungeons and search ruins where the remains of once-great stone Titans jut from the ground

Defeat bosses to earn crests you can spend to unlock new classes.

  • 3 Boss Fights - Face the Squallreaver, the Earthbreaker and The Guardian

  • 5 Classes - Spend your crests to unlock the Warrior, Ranger, Mage, Forager or Villager. Choose your path.

  • 100+ Skills - Mix and match over 100 skills from every class you unlock, including 20+ active abilities, to create your own build

Brave Sorana on your own or team up with friends in online or LAN co-op.

  • Personal Loot - Dungeon and ruin chests hold separate loot for every player so you don’t need to steal from your friends

  • Fast Travel - Place portals to get back to base in an instant

  • World Settings - Choose your difficulty and adjust the danger from the storms

  • Shared Quests - Complete quests together and progress as a group

Add community-made content to your world whenever you want something new.

  • New Places to Explore - Bring community-made locations into your world

  • Level Editor - Create your own content with the built-in level editor and share it with others via Steam Workshop

  • New Equipment & Enemies - Add community-made gear and enemies to your world

  • Custom Game Rules - Change how your world plays with community-made rules

item.title: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
item.description:
Title: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
Genre: Adventure
Developer: Aspyr Media
Publisher: Aspyr Media
Release Date: Nov 10, 2026




About This Game

Shrek, Fiona, Donkey and friends are back!

DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale : From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time : Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

Travel back to a nostalgic era of gaming for some pick-up-and-play casual fun.

item.title: Never Sort By Color
item.description:
Title: Never Sort By Color
Genre: Casual , Simulation
Developer: Bryan Livingston
Publisher: Bryan Livingston
Release Date: Nov 10, 2026




About This Game

There is one rule of brick sorting. Everyone learns it the hard way.

You've inherited a workshop and a Pile that swallowed it whole. Never Sort By Color is a zen organization sim about setting it right - sorting an impossibly huge mountain of plastic bricks into a perfectly labeled workshop, one satisfying handful at a time.

Tame the Pile

The Pile doesn't look conquerable. That's the point. Start by picking out bricks one at a time, and grow into an unstoppable sorting machine:

  • Magnet Glove - aim at a part and every loose copy rips out of the Pile and streams into your hand.

  • Sorter's Eye - mark a part type and watch every instance glow through the chaos.

  • Sieve Tray - scoop, shake, and let gravity sort a whole load by size in one motion.

  • Bucket Sort - bind bins to hotkeys and fling bricks blind over your shoulder, pure muscle memory.

  • Locators - hold up any brick and its home drawer lights up across the room.

Buy bins, trays, and cabinet walls. Stack them into towers. Label everything. Watch the floor appear.

Pull the parts. Watch it build.

Instruction books lie scattered around the workshop, each one a MOC waiting for parts. Crack one open, pull its bill of materials from your perfect drawers, and watch the model build itself, brick by brick - a time-lapse of parts flying up and clicking into place, stud by stud.

This is where your sorting pays off or bites. Honest drawers mean a full kit pulls in seconds. A contaminated drawer means the tray rejects your wrong part right in front of you.

Finished models don't ship away - they fill your workshop. A fire truck on the windowsill. A spaceship hung from the ceiling. Pick one up and swoosh it around the room. I won't tell.

Chaos in. Order out.

  • One workshop, one enormous Pile, one deeply satisfying loop.

  • No timers, no fail states - just you, the bricks, and the quiet click of things going where they belong.

  • Every brick you sort visibly shrinks the mountain. The before/after is the game.

The Rule

Title: Never Sort By Color
Genre: Casual , Simulation
Developer: Bryan Livingston
Publisher: Bryan Livingston
Release Date: Nov 10, 2026




About This Game

There is one rule of brick sorting. Everyone learns it the hard way.

You've inherited a workshop and a Pile that swallowed it whole. Never Sort By Color is a zen organization sim about setting it right - sorting an impossibly huge mountain of plastic bricks into a perfectly labeled workshop, one satisfying handful at a time.

Tame the Pile

The Pile doesn't look conquerable. That's the point. Start by picking out bricks one at a time, and grow into an unstoppable sorting machine:

  • Magnet Glove - aim at a part and every loose copy rips out of the Pile and streams into your hand.

  • Sorter's Eye - mark a part type and watch every instance glow through the chaos.

  • Sieve Tray - scoop, shake, and let gravity sort a whole load by size in one motion.

  • Bucket Sort - bind bins to hotkeys and fling bricks blind over your shoulder, pure muscle memory.

  • Locators - hold up any brick and its home drawer lights up across the room.

Buy bins, trays, and cabinet walls. Stack them into towers. Label everything. Watch the floor appear.

Pull the parts. Watch it build.

Instruction books lie scattered around the workshop, each one a MOC waiting for parts. Crack one open, pull its bill of materials from your perfect drawers, and watch the model build itself, brick by brick - a time-lapse of parts flying up and clicking into place, stud by stud.

This is where your sorting pays off or bites. Honest drawers mean a full kit pulls in seconds. A contaminated drawer means the tray rejects your wrong part right in front of you.

Finished models don't ship away - they fill your workshop. A fire truck on the windowsill. A spaceship hung from the ceiling. Pick one up and swoosh it around the room. I won't tell.

Chaos in. Order out.

  • One workshop, one enormous Pile, one deeply satisfying loop.

  • No timers, no fail states - just you, the bricks, and the quiet click of things going where they belong.

  • Every brick you sort visibly shrinks the mountain. The before/after is the game.

The Rule

Sorting by color feels right. It looks beautiful. And every brick collector on earth will tell you the same thing: you will never find anything again.

Sort by part. Always by part.

Never. Sort. By. Color.
